plain: The lime delight tokens are deprecated and hidden from the docs, but their CSS variables still work, so nothing breaks; avoid them in new code.

steps.plain: --semantic-accent-delight-* still resolve to the same lime; they are hidden while lime is parked (hds#857) and may come back, so keep existing uses and add none.
--primitive-color-lime-* still resolve; the ramp only feeds the hidden delight accent, so add no new uses.
